verdict.rationale: The only pricing-related evidence is a quality guarantee: Lorikeet refunds the AI portion of an interaction when Coach scores it badly. That implies some outcome-linked billing, but the pack never shows a published per-resolution price, and the 'hard execution caps' it mentions are runtime guardrails, not spend controls. missing for 10: published pricing or rate card, an explicit per-resolution billing model, spending caps or budget controls, evidence that pricing is not an enterprise quote, independent corroboration.
